summary: Tamil Nadu reconstituted its Real Estate Regulatory Authority while announcing initiatives for Sivakasi manufacturers to enter space supply chains. Heavy monsoon rain triggered dam releases, groundwater warnings, and flooding in Coimbatore hospital wards. Meanwhile, transport unions and civic activists staged protests over e-bus deals and road raising.

stories.headline: TN Reconstitutes Real Estate Authority, Appoints New Chair
stories.summary: The Tamil Nadu government has reconstituted the Real Estate Regulatory Authority (TNRERA). Former senior IAS officer K. Phanindra Reddy has been named as its new chairperson.

stories.headline: Sivakasi Fireworks Units to Diversify into Defence and Space
stories.summary: The Tamil Nadu government will support Sivakasi pyrotechnic manufacturers to diversify into defence and space supply chains. The initiative leverages local expertise in energetics.

stories.headline: Study Warns Proposed Thoothukudi Coal Plant May Increase State Debt
stories.summary: A study by CRH cautions that establishing a new coal-fired power plant in Thoothukudi could burden Tamil Nadu with high financial debt. Experts advocate shifting focus to renewable energy.

stories.headline: Flood Alert Issued as Surplus Water Released from Krishnagiri Dam
stories.summary: Authorities issued a flood alert along downstream river banks following surplus water release from the Krishnagiri dam. Local officials advised residents in low-lying areas to stay cautious.

stories.headline: Over 500 Fishing Boats Grounded in Vedaranyam Amid Cyclone Warning
stories.summary: More than 500 fishing trawlers were grounded at Vedaranyam coast due to severe weather alerts in the Bay of Bengal. Fishermen have been advised not to venture into the sea.

stories.headline: Salem and Thanjavur Face Severe Groundwater Depletion, Survey Finds
stories.summary: A Central survey revealed that Salem and Thanjavur are among the worst-affected TN districts due to excessive groundwater extraction. The report urges immediate water conservation measures.

stories.headline: Demand for CCTVs in TN Exam Halls Grows Following Centum Surge
stories.summary: Education stakeholders have requested CCTV cameras in all board exam halls across Tamil Nadu. The demand follows a sharp spike in students scoring 100 percent marks in recent examinations.
stories.key_fact: CCTV request for all exam halls

stories.headline: TN Wind Equipment Manufacturers Expect Boost from New Trade Deals
stories.summary: Tamil Nadu wind power equipment manufacturers are set to expand export volumes under newly signed free trade agreements. Industry groups expect increased global demand for locally made turbines.

stories.headline: Transport Union Demands Cancellation of ₹80 per Km Electric Bus Deal
stories.summary: The TN State Transport Employees Federation urged the government to cancel the electric bus contract. The union raised concerns over high operating costs fixed between ₹77 and ₹80 per km.
stories.key_fact: Cost set at ₹77 to ₹80 per km

stories.headline: Incessant Rain Causes Flooding Inside Coimbatore Government Hospital
stories.summary: Heavy downpours led to waterlogging inside patient wards at the Coimbatore Government Hospital. Medical staff initiated drainage operations to clear stagnant water and ensure patient safety.

summary: The Tamil Nadu government announced major developmental projects, including a ₹2,882-crore housing initiative and 50,000 free agricultural power connections. Heavy rainfall triggered red alerts and landslides in southern districts, while the state mourned the passing of culinary legend Chef Damu.

stories.headline: TN Announces ₹2,882 Crore Project to Build 12,648 New Houses
stories.summary: The Tamil Nadu government has approved a massive housing initiative for the state. A total of 12,648 new houses will be constructed across various regions at an estimated outlay of ₹2,882 crore.

stories.headline: IMD Issues Red Alert for 3 TN Districts Amid Heavy Rain and Slides
stories.summary: Continuous downpours triggered landslides on Kodaikanal roads and severed access to several villages. The weather department issued a red alert for Madurai, Theni, and Dindigul districts.

stories.headline: Padma Shri Awardee Chef Damu Passes Away at 72 in Chennai
stories.summary: Culinary icon and Guinness World Record holder Chef K. Damodaran passed away in Chennai due to health complications. Leaders and television personalities expressed condolences over his death.

stories.headline: TN Government Sanctions ₹750 Crore for 50,000 Farm Power Links
stories.summary: The state government issued an official order to provide 50,000 new free electricity connections to farmers. An amount of ₹750 crore has been sanctioned to execute the project.

stories.headline: Chennai MTC Wins National Award for Urban Transport Financing
stories.summary: The Metropolitan Transport Corporation in Chennai bagged a national award for its innovative urban transport financing initiatives. The recognition highlights municipal transit reforms in the state.

stories.headline: SRMIST to Host Semiconductor Summit 2026 in Chennai on Oct 27
stories.summary: SRMIST and The Hindu will conduct the Semiconductor Summit 2026 in Chennai on October 27. Industry experts, academics, and researchers will discuss India's chip technology ecosystem.

stories.headline: Pallikaranai Marshland Becomes Year-Round Habitat for Pelicans
stories.summary: Spot-billed pelicans have begun staying year-round at the Pallikaranai marshland in Chennai. Conservation efforts and steady water availability have supported bird populations in the urban wetland.

stories.headline: Chennai to Host 1st Chola Chess Open International Grandmasters Event
stories.summary: Chennai will play host to the inaugural Chola Chess Open International Grandmasters Tournament. Top international players and rising grandmasters are scheduled to participate in the championship.

stories.headline: TN Police Bust Multi-State Drug Ring, Key Suspect Arrested
stories.summary: Tamil Nadu police dismantled a major methamphetamine trafficking network spanning Delhi, Bengaluru, and Chennai. Officers arrested a key operative involved in transporting illicit drugs across state lines.

stories.headline: Onion Prices Touch ₹60 per Kg at Chennai’s Koyambedu Market
stories.summary: Wholesale onion prices surged again at the Koyambedu market in Chennai, touching ₹60 per kilogram. Supply disruptions from producing states led to the recent rise in retail costs.
